definition: a sweet flaky pastry filled with fruit
description: A flower market street on a damp morning. A young man in a white chef's jacket, a white apron and a white cap rides an old bicycle over the cobbles, balancing a big metal tray of round golden pastries filled with cherry and apricot high on one hand. A pigeon swoops down, grabs one pastry in its beak and flies off over his head while he looks up in surprise and keeps riding. Buckets of tulips and eucalyptus line the street, and a woman behind a stall laughs.
